research_legs.summary: PR #4499 is an open non-draft P0 kind/bug by Smarterburn; original head edbb2c257 has clean GitHub CI and no reviews; merge gates still require Sheriff evidence.
Read-only reproduction found bd show can resolve gt-pr-4499 while bd mol bond dry-run cannot under the same context, supporting a formula bond authority split.
Sling verification selects target authority, but formula mutation paths recomputed cwd-derived authority; recommended first-class target Beads context.
ResolveBeadsDirForID plus WithBeadsDir is the existing canonical authority-pinning path; one-off direct fallback pin alone would be a bandaid.
On current upstream the direct formula bond path is canonical; fix should pin the current formula mutation commands rather than revive legacy wisp/bond layering.
Source issue handling is consistently ID-driven; formula bond should align to the same bead-owned authority to avoid split writes.
Original PR adds a local WithBeadsDir in bondFormulaDirect. Intent is correct, but focused regression coverage and current-main adaptation are required.
Existing tests cover routing primitives and formula direct bond separately but not the exact rig/HQ target Beads authority under poisoned env.
ResolveBeadsDirForID plus argv-based BdCmd/WithBeadsDir is safe under trusted town routes; no shell injection or beadID path traversal found.
Best fix is a tiny shared target-authority helper, not per-prefix exceptions, retries, or repo-wide routing churn.
Original PR labels have exactly one kind/priority/status but status/reviewing is not merge-ready; no unresolved comments or review blockers found.
Identified gt-pr-sheriff-check schema, 15 research, 5 pre-review, 5 post-review, label, cleanup, verification, replacement, attribution, and blocker-scan gates.
Original PR is not superseded on upstream/main, but final replacement must refresh to exact current upstream after #4484 advanced main.

Recommended maintainer replacement/fixup, preserving Smarterburn attribution, adding focused tests, and avoiding merge-as-is until gates pass.
